base_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl ca-certificates
activation_command: export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && export GOPATH=/root/go && export GOBIN=$GOPATH/bin
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && export GOPATH=/root/go && go version && echo ACTIVATION_OK'

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: go test automatically resolves dependencies from go.mod
runtime_profile.notes: Go modules workspace with go.work file for multi-module development. The auth submodule contains the fix target.

notes: Go 1.21 base image recommended to match project's go.mod requirement (go 1.19+). Git and curl are included in system packages. The project uses Go modules with a go.work workspace file. Test target is in auth/grpctransport package with test TestGrpcCredentialsProvider_TokenType.
